title: Great value and failing shap
text: Great value and failing shap. Just ordered a second knife. For the price a fantastic buy. Size is about right and feels good in my hand. Not sure how well it will hold an edge, but for 14 bucks do not care.

product_metadata.title: MICHELANGELO Super Sharp Professional Chef's Knife with Etched Pattern, High Carbon Stainless Steel Japanese Knife, Chef Knife for Kitchen
features: HIGH CARBON STAINLESS STEEL – Manufactured from high-quality stainless steel that features ultra-sharp and maintains its functionality for a long time. Ideal for tasks both large and small. It is the all-purpose utensil, from cutting meats, to chopping veggies and herbs, to using the knife’s side to smash cloves of garlic. Get Professional results without having to spend a lot of money!

The blade shapes are designed specifically to reduce fatigue and to providing maximum comfort. Cutting/Chopping no longer needs to be a dreaded task.

The blades of this 8 inch chef knife are heat treated and ice hardened, thus making chipping, cracking, or breaking virtually impossible. With its’ full tang design and rounded handle, it is moisture, heat and impact resistant.
